title: Congestion Identification Method in RLNC Based Wirless Networks and It's Impact on QoS Parameters
content: Wireless multicast networks are progressively utilizing random linear network coding (RLNC), a progression that has been advanced by the rising prominence of the Internet of Things, 5G, and e-health.But the efficiency of these networks has been hindered by the large quantity of data they gather. Thus congestion may be occasioned by the enormous amount of data generated at any node in such an application. A new approach for detecting network congestion through algebraic means is presented in this work, using well-known algebraic technique called SVD (singular value decomposition). Data analysis cannot be performed using ordinary This is especially true for networks when nodes demand more system resources, such when people are having interactive video sessions. operations; therefore, we apply a statistical concept called the coefficient of variation to massive data sets to reach a conclusion about congestion in the network.
